description: IHDP-style synthetic dataset with heterogeneous treatment effects
name: IHDP
treatment: Intervention program for low birth weight children
data_origin: SYNTHETIC - generated from scratch using formula-based simulation (Hill 2011 style)
what_is_real: ATE reference value (~4.0 from literature), number of units/covariates (747, 25), covariate names, study design
what_is_synthetic: ALL numerical data: covariates ~N(0,1), treatment from logistic PS model, outcomes from linear formulas with heterogeneous effects
note: SYNTHETIC DATA. No actual IHDP participant data is included. Generated to match statistical properties reported in Hill (2011).
